text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) had finally 
arrived. Her manager had come to watch and 
see how Gold City would run.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Your expression has changed. You look, 
like, totally refreshed.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I wonder what kind of trick you 
pulled?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What a nasty way to put it...
choice_data_list: I was just having a conversation with her.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
However, no matter what kind of results I 
produce, if there's no charm in my running 
itself, then...

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
I expect you to keep your promise to give 
up racing. No problems with that, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, let me ask you just one thing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Do you want to be enchanted by me today? 
Or... would you rather watch me run a 
pathetic race?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: ...To be completely honest, I don't know.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
"However, there is one thing I can state 
with absolute certainty. And that is—"

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
My "Gold City" isn't someone who's allowed 
to stumble in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
She's an Umamusume who can truly shine 
basking in the spotlight and applause of 
the entire world.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for bothering you right before 
the race. Well, good luck out there.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't belong to Managie, nor do I 
belong to anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Selfish expectations, empty praise. I've 
had enough of it all...
choice_data_list: Let's run for your own sake.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: On this path that I have chosen—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Tamamo-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Not even on your radar, huh. Well, 
can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
From my senpai's perspective, I'm just a 
boring coward who dropped out of the race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, even so. Because I want to 
run."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to keep running... To you, 
I—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
To you, to anyone! There's no way I'm 
losing today...!
